high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2024, held in Las Vegas. The main focus of the image is a futuristic-looking device that appears to be a holographic or virtual reality display. Two individuals are interacting with it: one person is standing outside the device, extending their hand as if to touch or interact with the person inside, while the other person is inside the device, appearing as a hologram or virtual representation.
